description.raw: Mehira marks a target area with her kiss, striking all enemies within 2 tiles 6 times, with each strike dealing 50% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage. After a short delay, she unleashes a powerful blast in the same area, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage. Enemies hit by the powerful blast become charmed for 3s.
active: Mehira marks a target area with her kiss, striking all enemies within 2 tiles 6 times, with each strike dealing 50% (ATK-based) + 5% (SP-based) damage.
After a short delay, she unleashes a powerful blast in the same area, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.
Enemies hit by the powerful blast become charmed for 3s.

text: Increases the powerful blast damage to 190% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).

Increases the powerful blast damage to 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based).

description.raw: Mehira lashes her whip at all units, friend or foe, in a 3-tile frontal arc 5 times. Each hit causes a unit to lose 20% (ATK-based) + 3% (SP-based) HP. If an allied unit is hit, they gain 25 Haste for 8s, and their HP loss from this skill is reduced by 90%. Mehira always targets the direction that hits the most enemies.

description.raw: Mehira summons an illusion of herself on the tile closest to the enemy lineup, bewitching all enemies and making them rush mindlessly toward the illusion for 2.2 + 0.1 (SP-based)s. When a battle starts, she summons such an illusion on a symmetrical tile across from where she stands.

description.raw: Increases Life Drain by 8. Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 6%, up to 18%.
active: Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 6%, up to 18%.

text: Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 8%, up to 24%.
Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 10%, up to 30%.

description.raw: When a battle starts, Mehira summons 3 voidlings around her. Each voidling attacks an enemy every 1.5s, dealing 40% (ATK-based) damage. If Mehira takes a hit that would reduce her HP below 20%, she sacrifices a voidling to block that damage. She then becomes untargetable for 2.5s and instantly recovers 20% of her max HP.
active: When a battle starts, Mehira summons 3 voidlings around her.
Each voidling attacks an enemy every 1.5s, dealing 40% (ATK-based) damage.
If Mehira takes a hit that would reduce her HP below 20%, she sacrifices a voidling to block that damage.
She then becomes untargetable for 2.5s and instantly recovers 20% of her max HP.

text: Increases the damage dealt by each voidling attack to 50% (ATK-based).
Increases the damage dealt by each voidling attack to 60% (ATK-based).
Mehira stores any excess healing she receives.
Each time the stored amount reaches 50% of her inital max HP, she summons one extra voidling, up to 3 per battle.

description.raw: Increases the damage taken by enemies charmed with Mehira's Euphoric Rush or bewitched with her Alluring Mirage by 15%. This effect does not stack.
active: Increases the damage taken by enemies charmed with Mehira's Euphoric Rush or bewitched with her Alluring Mirage by 15%.
